}}{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Holiday Recipes|Holiday Recipes]] | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Dessert]]
==Ingredients==

* 4 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (2½ [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]]) firm, ripe [[Cookbook:Pear|pears]] peeled, cored, and [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
* 12 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] [[Cookbook:Cranberry|cranberries]]
* ⅓ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]], divided
* ¾ cup [[Cookbook:Oats|rolled oats]]
* ⅔ cup sliced [[Cookbook:Almond|almonds]]
* ⅔ cup firmly packed [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] cut into pieces
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]

==Procedure==

# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven_temperatures|375°F]].
# [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|Toss]] pears, cranberries, sugar, and ¼ teaspoon cinnamon in a 9x9-inch [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]] until blended.
# Combine oats, almonds, brown sugar, butter, flour, and remaining ¼ teaspoon cinnamon in large bowl. Blend with fingertips.
# Sprinkle crumble over fruit and pat down lightly.
# [[Cookbook:Bake|Bake]] until pears are tender and topping is golden, about 45 minutes.
# Serve hot or warm.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Try baking in a 15-inch [[Cookbook:Dutch Oven|Dutch oven]]—place on 12 briquettes, and top with 19 briquettes. Cook for 35–45 minutes, checking crisp after 30 minutes.
